subject: Re: grid.ls is no longer working for ggplot

messages.author: a3c668b849637905
messages.subject: Re: grid.ls is no longer working for ggplot
parts:
Hi,

Things have changed since gtable was introduced, and grid.ls doesn't know what to do with grobs of this class which are new in the grid ecosystem. names(g) and str(g) give you more info.

HTH,

b.



On 15 February 2013 10:42, Yunfeng Zhang <zyw...@gmail.com> wrote:
I tried to run the following code from the github wiki page "Editing raw Grid objects from a ggplot":
data  <- data.frame(Name = c("A","B","C","D","E","F","G","H"), y = c(100,200,300,400,200,300,400,350))
p <- ggplot(data,aes(x=Name,y=y)) + geom_bar()
g <- ggplotGrob(p)
grid.ls(g)

And the output is just:

layout

And that's all. I think it's supposed to be a lot of things here.  

--
